Before: a muffin (~80-100 g, ~300 kcal), blueberries (~50-70 g, ~35 kcal), milk (~200 g, probably whole milk at ~125 kcal, or lower-fat at ~100), and water (no calories).

After: the blueberries are gone, the milk is nearly all gone (a small residue remains), and the muffin is mostly eaten, with a small piece of wrapper or crust left on the plate.

Muffin: about 90 g before, with roughly 10 g left, so ~80 g eaten at ~3.3 kcal/g = ~265 kcal.
Blueberries: ~60 g, ~35 kcal.
Milk: ~210 g before, with ~15 g left, so ~195 g eaten at ~0.62 kcal/g = ~120 kcal.

Total: ~265 + 35 + 120 = ~420 kcal.
Mass: 80 + 60 + 195 = 335 g.
